support desk · kb
Triage: duplicate reports

owner support desk
accepted
reviewed 2024-06-11 · 896 days ago · stale

Nobody has re-read this page in 896 days. Check it against the live views before you rely on it.

A busy morning brings hundreds of reports about the same thing. We keep one ticket per issue and merge every duplicate into it, so engineering sees one thread with a count.

The rule

A report is a duplicate when its subject line matches the subject of an open ticket (decision 0001):

lowercase the subject and strip punctuation;
look for an open ticket with the same subject;
found one: merge the report into it. None: open a new ticket.

Matching on subject is fast and needs no reading. During an incident that matters more than anything else.

decision-0001.title: 0001 · Duplicates share a subject line · support kb
decision-0001.text:
support desk · kb
0001 · Duplicates share a subject line

owner rune
accepted
reviewed 2024-06-11 · 896 days ago · stale

Nobody has re-read this page in 896 days. Check it against the live views before you rely on it.

Date: 11 June 2024 · Deciders: Rune (product), support desk

Context

Reports arrive faster than the desk can read them. During incidents the same problem comes in hundreds of times, and engineering asks for one ticket per issue.

Decision

Two reports are the same issue when their subject lines match after lowercasing and stripping punctuation. The desk merges on subject alone; nobody has to read the body.

Consequences
Fast: one person can triage an incident morning.
Reports with different subjects about the same bug end up in separate tickets. Accepted; engineering merges them later.

#4471 · dates parse mm/dd in eu locales

owner support desk
known

Since April, people have told us their bookings land on the wrong day: a month flipped. By 4 October the desk had 412 reports.

Merged as one issue. The parser reads dates month first, and our tenants write the day first. The fix is queued.

Known. One issue, one fix queued.
